advancements.cortescombat.arcabuz: A bamboo, a firer, a dispenser and some wood. The Firestone is the expensive part.
advancements.cortescombat.familia.alabar: Spear, hook and edge on one pole: it sweeps whatever the arc holds.
advancements.cortescombat.familia.daga: Swift above everything, and the only one with a wooden grip.
advancements.cortescombat.familia.martil: Against armour there is no subtlety, only weight. Consecutive hits stack.
advancements.cortescombat.familia.ropera: Fine steel that learned to strike at a distance: reach above all.
advancements.cortescombat.familia.shotel: The curved blade of the sabre: it parries, and a charge lands two cuts.
enchantment.cortescombat.adrenalina.desc: Pain straightens you: the blow lands softer and your legs wake up. At the higher level, the debt comes back with you.
enchantment.cortescombat.apunalar.desc: The one who does not see you takes double.
enchantment.cortescombat.astilladora.des: Blocking this edge tires you twice as fast.
enchantment.cortescombat.audacity.desc: The lunge costs less with each level; audacity pays for itself.
enchantment.cortescombat.aventurero.desc: Those who fall by your hand leave more experience.
enchantment.cortescombat.barredor.desc: The sweep reaches where you were not looking.
enchantment.cortescombat.capacitor.desc: What they throw at you comes back as lightning.
enchantment.cortescombat.cicatrizador.de: The wound you open closes badly.
enchantment.cortescombat.culata.desc: The stock strikes like a ram.
The charged blow leaves the wound open, and the wound keeps bleeding.
enchantment.cortescombat.desvio_vampiric: Every parry steals a breath of life.
enchantment.cortescombat.dry_powder.desc: Dry powder reloads sooner: the arcabuz speaks again.
enchantment.cortescombat.ensarte.desc: The thrust carries on and finds another body.
enchantment.cortescombat.estocada.desc: The lunge's thrust slips between the plates.
The weapon turns to feather and the arm arrives sooner.
Every plate on the target works for your edge.
enchantment.cortescombat.gold_echo.desc: Your hit sets it alight: it glows for everyone, and the world hits it harder.
enchantment.cortescombat.golden_hands.de: What the shovel tears loose lands in your pocket.
The hoe puts the seed back in the earth, and the high level collects twice.
enchantment.cortescombat.gripa.desc: Hits leave muck, and muck weighs.
enchantment.cortescombat.guardia_firme.d: The first blow of each truce breaks without a price.
enchantment.cortescombat.inercia.desc: The chain's shove lifts the target off the ground.
enchantment.cortescombat.life_steal.desc: Every cut gives you back a thread of the life you took.
enchantment.cortescombat.mecha_corta.des: The fuse burns down before the eye expects it.
enchantment.cortescombat.mella.desc: The target's armour comes apart in your hands.
enchantment.cortescombat.midas_tool.desc: The ore comes out of the stone golden, and the level decides how often.
enchantment.cortescombat.midas_touch.des: Every body that falls spits gold, and the deeper the level, the more gold.
enchantment.cortescombat.miner_frenzy.de: Stone gives way faster with every block broken; a pause wipes the count.
enchantment.cortescombat.pala_antimateri: The orb calls everything around it and erases it.
enchantment.cortescombat.paliza.desc: The blow that closes the streak sends the target away.
enchantment.cortescombat.phantom_block.d: Some blocks hand over their treasure doubled.
Sometimes the edge finds the gap in the armour, and each level finds it more often.
enchantment.cortescombat.punta_fina.desc: Up close, the point finds the flesh.
enchantment.cortescombat.retirada.desc: Crouched, the lunge leaps backwards and the blow waits in your hand.
enchantment.cortescombat.rey_de_las_mosc: The shot leaves flies where it lands, and the flies stay.
The hammer's chain holds one more beat with each level.
enchantment.cortescombat.riposte.desc: After your guard, the blow looks for the seam in the armour.
enchantment.cortescombat.sanguijuela.des: Their blood ends up in your wound.
enchantment.cortescombat.santa_muerte.de: What you kill leaves a reeking air behind.
The sweep that kills nobody gives part of your arm back.
enchantment.cortescombat.segundo_aliento: When your guard falls, the arm catches fire one last time.
enchantment.cortescombat.sentencia.desc: On the fifth hit of the chain, the body bursts.
enchantment.cortescombat.steel_reflex.de: The parry returns sooner with each level: the steel remembers the blow.
enchantment.cortescombat.trabazon.desc: The charged blow pins the target in place.
enchantment.cortescombat.wind_walker.des: The wind walks with you; each level lengthens your stride.
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.arcabuz: Spends a Firestone from the inventory: right click reloads, left click fires
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.halberd: Right click: sweeps the whole arc, and costs the same cooldown as a hit
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.mace: The damage is the fall: up to %s, falling %s blocks. Landing a hit cancels the fall
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.ropera: Right click: forward lunge, and it passes through several
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.sabre: Right click: parry. A %s s window, a %s s cooldown
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.trident: Right click throws it; charged, it pulls the target in
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.warhammer: Escalates with each consecutive hit; the streak lasts %s s
tooltip.cortescombat.special.fusee: Right Click: spends a Firestone, and a second later burns the whole cone
tooltip.cortescombat.special.multi_hit: Right Click: hits everything in the cone
tooltip.cortescombat.special.parry: Right Click: parry, returns the hit you take
